question.problem:
Which of the following congruences have *precisely three* solutions modulo $24?$

I. $18x≡12\,(\text{mod}\,24)$

II. $9x≡5\,(\text{mod}\,24)$

III. $15x≡18\,(\text{mod}\,24)$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14269988/assets/b65fc4830e0b060d62226b41d5ccb7bdc63d0ad594f7a42a2628597409bba3af.png)

      

Recall the following facts regarding the congruence $ax≡b\,(\text{mod}\,n):$

- The congruence has no solutions modulo $n$ if and only if 

$$
\text{gcd}(a,n)\,\text{⧸}|\,b.
$$

- The congruence has $\text{gcd}(a,n)$ solutions modulo $n$ if and only if 

$$
\text{gcd}(a,n)\,|\,b.
$$

With that in mind, let's examine our congruences.

- Congruence I has six solutions modulo $24.$ We have $a=18$ and $n=24$, and so

$$
\text{gcd}(a,n)=\text{gcd}(18,24)=6.
$$

Since $b=12$ is divisible by $6,$ this congruence has $6$ solutions.

- Congruence II has no solutions. We have $a=9$ and $n=24$, and so

$$
\text{gcd}(a,n)=\text{gcd}(9,24)=3.
$$

Since $b=5$ is not divisible by $3,$ this congruence has no solutions.

- Congruence III has three solutions modulo $24.$ We have $a=15$ and $n=24$, and so

$$
\text{gcd}(a,n)=\text{gcd}(15,24)=3.
$$

Since $b=18$ is divisible by $3,$ this congruence has $3$ solutions.

Therefore, the correct answer is "III only".
